Finally, you muster the courage to embark on an adventure with your fairy familiar to find and bring back your childhood best friend.
Check the cat woman's shop; there might be something that interests you.
The cat woman who runs the shop is somewhat grumpy because she hasn't had the chance to eat lunch.
You managed to read the sinful thoughts of the fisherman. Perhaps this is your chance to explore your powers.
Lili pushes you to be more proactive in training your succubus powers, so she sends you to try to seduce the cat woman who runs the shop. It should be easier since you know her.
There is a high-rank demon who has been stealing alcohol shipments. You decide to find and defeat her to see if you can get information about Ava.
You're very lucky! You recognized one of the women who appeared in your mother's XXX magazines! She says she'll give you a special service for old times' sake.
You found a woman with violet pigtails at the corner of the bar. She says she can lend you money, but you must pay her back with an additional ten percent.
There's a cat woman playing very mean pranks on the villagers, and they're blaming Callie's daughter. Find the real culprit and save Callie's daughter!
The plant woman from the shop told you she's very thirsty, and Lili suggested buying her beer to see if she'll give you discounts while drunk.
A dragon woman fell from the sky among the prisoners and seems to be fighting to prevent a crystal from being stolen. Lili suggests we help her; maybe they'll reward us with something valuable.
There's a strange woman with pink hair hiding in a corner of the circus. Find out why people are talking about her.
You found your favorite heroine! Sam, the protector of Tricotex. Prove that you have what it takes to embark on a capture mission with her.
Someone is impersonating a knight of Elira to scam people. Catch them and be the heroine you always wanted to be!
Kristoff, a VIP customer at the bar, is very angry and asks if you can buy him some premium cigarettes to help him calm down.
The hotel secretary informs you that you've caught the attention of a woman who will be waiting for you on the top floor of the hotel. Hmm, what could she want? It might be important.
You've become a minion of a seemingly powerful individual! They order you to bring the dimensional fracture, which looks like a floating crystal, to leave this dimension.
There was a collapse in the cave, leaving many miners trapped. Wait until the knight of Elira clears the passage.
There are some rumors of strange sounds coming from the Silent Forest at night. What could it be?
An Onahole is desperate to buy a boat and is selling her body to do so. As an act of charity, help her.
Ivy, a honey slime, recognizes you as an adventurer who helps people and asks if you can help her find a part of herself that hasn't returned.
You heard the Grand Captain of the Elira Guards arguing with a woman about the ineptitude of the knights. Maybe if you help them, they can assist you in your quest.
You encountered Faye, a space-dimensional traveler trapped in your dimension. You decided to help her because you felt sorry for her.
Vasuki tells you that something bad is happening at the mushroom house in the magenta swamp. Upon investigating, it seems that there may be human trafficking and drug activities occurring there.
You found someone smelling the flowers, but as soon as you spoke to them, they attacked you. Find out what's really going on!
There's something about Marael that doesn't quite convince you. Look into what she's really hiding.
A letter addressed to Marael gives you clues that a woman named Willow also contacted Ava. Look for her to gather more information.
There's a bard woman looking for an adventurer to inspire her. Show her that you're a worthy adventurer capable of inspiring others!
After being attacked by a pervert who opened his leather coat and showed you everything, something awakened inside of you.
The island is cordoned off because someone stole the relics from the church. As part of the deal to stay on the island, you agree to help the knights of Elira search for the relics.
An Onahole stuck to the wall in the VIP area of the bar tells you that if you buy her entire outfit, she'll give you a rimjob!
Lili says you're very stinky and need a bath.
The librarian is lost, and no one knows where she is. Look for her, and perhaps you'll find more information about the people who go missing on the island.
Gildfried, a businessman on vacation on the island, unfortunately lost his briefcase, which is very important to him.
Lemmy, a green monster outside an automated carriage, talks to Lili and asks for help because his mistress is having trouble.
Sakura is working at the renowned fast food restaurant Smooshers! She asks for your help in searching for the lost uniforms.
One of Vasera's clones has gained autonomy. Vasera will go search for it and neutralize it. She advises you to kill it if you encounter it.
Sieki got angry with you because even though she already paid the debt to MsHonney, you're still in the VIP area. Now you follow her orders to avoid making her angrier.
The farmer confesses that she would like to work with less clothing. How could you help her work more comfortably?
The fortune teller confessed to you that she would like to have a red crystal orb because with it she could see her own future.
The water nymph who works at the bar is looking for love but is insecure because she doesn't know if people approach her for the beer or if they genuinely want something with her.
Accidentally, you ruin Naoki's concoction just as he's entering mating season, so you decide to help him.
Lucy the bard is having trouble with an Onahole, so you decide to help her with whatever she needs.
There are portals for self-satisfaction in the VIP area of the bar, but a witch won't let you use them.
Sieki has a big problem and makes you a deal you can't refuse: you just have to attend to the clients in the VIP area while she's away, and you'll become a VIP customer.
A hospital robot offers anal cleaning services for just three thousand Arcs. It's not a bad idea to keep clean every now and then.
A story you read in the library seems strange to you, so you decide to look for more information about it.
There's a guy offering his services to make fursuits, which catches your attention, so you decide to save up for one.
There's an Onahole that has the same tone as you, which strangely excites you.
In a nightclub, you find two gothic girls with big butts dancing, something you can't let pass in your life.
Upon entering the usually closed public restroom, you find an idol vomiting, with many people screaming and demanding the show. What could be happening?
There is a proliferation of slimes attacking and kidnapping women. Do your best to help and get to the bottom of this!
A being living in the pond enters Line's mind and psychologically strips her bare with questions she's not prepared to hear or face.
You don't know what's happening; you have mental gaps, and days and nights seem to pass in seconds.
You have committed serious mistakes that haunt you at night, so you decide to confess to expiate your sins.
Callie invites you to meet her family, which seems more serious than what you're looking for, but it would be rude not to go.
You found a place that can serve you for sleeping while you investigate the island.
You need more power, so you beg Marael to help you unlock your succubus powers.
The thieves on the island aren't just any criminals; they were actually stealing to maintain an orphanage, without which everything would collapse.
You met Futaba your trusted futanari in the forest, what could she be doing?
The barn is very busy due to the issues happening on the island. Help them however you can so that the barn can open.
Rynn is frustrated because the last fight with you didn't end, so she challenges you to a beer drinking duel.
Lili is angry with Line because she believes Line is completely ignorant about sex, and challenges her to a competition to see who is the better onahole.
The milk on this island has very strange properties.
